# Code of Conduct

This is a small project, mostly used by people who teach with Mesa. The rules are
short because I would rather they be read than be exhaustive.

## Expected behaviour

Be civil and assume the other person is trying to help. Critique the code, the
data or the argument, not the person. Disagreement is fine and useful; contempt
is not.

Much of what comes through here is teaching material someone wrote for their own
students. Treat it that way — pointing out that a notebook is on a dead Mesa
dialect is the entire purpose of this project, and it is never a comment on
whoever wrote it.

## Unacceptable behaviour

Harassment, insults, or personal attacks. Discriminatory language or imagery,
including anything targeting someone's background, identity or beliefs.
Publishing someone's private information. Persistently derailing a thread after
being asked to stop.

## Scope

Issues, pull requests, discussions and any other space where someone is taking
part in this project.

## Reporting

Email me at the address on my
[GitHub profile](https://github.com/omarkammouh), or open a private
[security advisory](https://github.com/omarkammouh/mesa-notebook-updater/security/advisories/new)
if you would rather it stay off the public tracker. I'll read it, keep it in
confidence, and reply. I'm the only maintainer, so if the report concerns me,
say so publicly or take it to GitHub Support.

## Enforcement

I may edit or delete comments, close issues or pull requests, or block accounts,
and I will say why when I do.
